query:
SELECT
                a.role = 'administrator' AS "administrator!",
                g.id AS "id?: GrantId",
                g.team_id AS "team_id?: TeamId"
            FROM human_accounts a
            LEFT JOIN effective_human_grants g
                ON g.actor_id = a.id
                AND g.scope_kind = $2
                AND g.scope_id = $3
                AND g.capability = $4
            WHERE a.id = $1 AND a.active
            ORDER BY g.id
